Package org.cha0scollective.wwpg.api.cee

Interface CeePropertyAdapter<T extends com.george_vi.electroenergetics.simulation.electrical_properties.ElectricalProperties>

Type Parameters:
T - exact registered electrical property class
public interface CeePropertyAdapter<T extends com.george_vi.electroenergetics.simulation.electrical_properties.ElectricalProperties>
Exact-class adapter for a custom CEE electrical property. Registration happens during RegisterCeePropertyAdaptersEvent and freezes before worlds begin ticking.

prepare captures current parameters without advancing history. A dynamic adapter may update captured state in beforeSubstep and commit history only in afterSubstep, which is invoked once after each accepted electrical substep. All numerical callbacks must avoid mutable world, block, entity, and client access. The owning CEE device remains responsible for gameplay, synchronization, and native serialization. This API supports two-terminal Norton/ideal-voltage models; custom coupled models use the general electrical API or native CEE transformer properties.

Dynamic adapters must implement checkpoint. WWPG keeps a whole-tick checkpoint plus a checkpoint for each substep. A rejected solve or callback failure restores the last committed tick before native gameplay can persist new state. Earlier accepted substeps within a rejected tick are rolled back. A checkpoint that throws violates this contract and causes explicit adapter isolation.
